race.comment: SENTALOA (9) brings the most reliable profile, having placed in all four starts and gone within half a length of Nightowl at Yarra Valley after being steadied in the straight. The first try at this trip looks a big tick and he draws to get every chance. Can get the job done this time around. MOLESWORTH (6) is third-up for they Hayes boys and has excuses around both runs this time in, including interference at Pakenham Synthetic before a fair Yarra Valley fifth. He was solid when out in trip third-up off a similar number last campaign and with a touch of luck in the running. KISSATTACK (11) is improving with racing, comes through the same Yarra Valley race and now gets Damian Lane, which is a meaningful rider change. GRINDING AWAY (3) was plain two back but was respected in betting when fourth at this track last start, and his previous placings around 2430m keep him in the winning mix. CLYDEBANK ROBBER (1) is a long-time maiden but can be thereabouts.
